item.title: Oil prices jump after Yemen’s Houthis claim attacks on Saudi facilities
item.description: Brent crude tops $106 a barrel after Iran-aligned rebel group claims to have successfully attacked Aramco facilities.

item.title: Saudi, Turkish, Pakistani chiefs plan urgent talks amid Yemen fighting
item.description: Saudi Arabia, Turkiye and Pakistan move to deepen defence coordination as Houthi attacks and Yemen fighting intensify.

item.title: Trump praises US-China friendship at state dinner with Xi Jinping
item.description: The two superpowers seek greater dialogue despite differences over issues such as Iran, Taiwan, AI and trade.

item.title: UAE bars Iranian airlines as US sanctions squeeze Iran’s aviation sector
item.description: UAE joins Oman, Iraq, Azerbaijan, Georgia and Turkmenistan in restricting access to Iranian airlines.

item.title: Iran war live: Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani army chiefs plan urgent meeting
item.description: Saudi, Turkish, Pakistani army chiefs invoke Mecca pact for urgent talks over Houthi attacks.

item.description: Trump, Xi seek stable US-China ties at the White House, but differences over Iran, Taiwan and trade remain unresolved.

item.title: Netanyahu defends Israeli military action as delegates walk out before UN speech
item.description: The Israeli leader labels those who left his speech at the UN General Assembly as "moral cowards".

item.title: Four civilians killed in Pakistani strikes in Afghanistan, Taliban says
item.description: Pakistan says it struck 10 targets, adding the strikes were "strictly limited to identified military objectives".

item.title: Priest killed and four injured in knife attack at Polish abbey
item.description: A male suspect from Ukraine was arrested after the stabbings in the town of Jarosław, police say.

item.title: Ethiopia's army says it has repelled attacks in first comment on fresh fighting
item.description: The military says its soldiers inflicted casualties as fears grow of a resumption of a full-blown civil war.
